FAQs
FAQs
1. Can Mibro GT sync with Android and iPhone?

Mibro GT is compatible with Android and iPhone. Download the Mibro Fit app and follow the on-screen steps to connect and sync your data.
2. What AI features does Mibro GT support?

Mibro GT has a built-in AI voice assistant for conversations, Q&A, schedule creation, and reminders. It also supports AI-generated watch faces for a more personalized experience.
3. Is the Mibro GT waterproof?

Mibro GT AI smartwatch features 5 ATM water resistance, making it suitable for swimming, surfing, and snorkeling.
4. Can Mibro GT track location, take calls, and show notifications?

Yes, this AI smartwatch has a GNSS chip for location tracking. It can answer and hang up calls and also supports message notifications, which need to be enabled in the Mibro Fit app under “Me” → “Set up.”
5. How bright is Mibro GT display?

Mibro GT AI smartwatch features an AMOLED display with up to 600 nits brightness.
6. How long does its battery last?

This AI smartwatch offers up to 8 days of battery life in daily use and up to 12 hours in GPS mode.
7. Does it sync with Apple Health / Strava / Google Fit?

Yes. Simply complete the required connection and setup.
8. Are the built-in apps on the smartwatch free to use?

Yes. The built-in apps on the smartwatch, as well as the Mibro Fit app on your phone, are free to use.
9. What are the warranty and return policies?

Mibro GT comes with a 12-month warranty. Refunds are processed within 14 days after approval. See the Return & Refund page for details.

Premium Stainless Steel Design

Crafted with elegant 316L stainless steel, the Mibro Watch GT blends timeless style with everyday durability for a refined look on any occasion.
Vibrant HD AMOLED Display

Enjoy crisp visuals on a 1.43‑inch AMOLED screen with 326 PPI, 60Hz refresh rate, and AOD—every detail comes to life with brilliant clarity.
AI‑Driven Smart Companion

Interact naturally with the built‑in AI Assistant for voice Q&A, schedule reminders, and even generate personalized watch faces with just your words.
100+ Sport Modes & Multi‑System GPS

Track over 100 activities with precision thanks to built‑in GPS/BeiDou/GLONASS/Galileo/QZSS support—ideal for both outdoor adventures and indoor workouts.
Comprehensive Health Guardian

Stay informed with 24/7 heart rate, blood oxygen, stress, and sleep monitoring—powered by advanced sensors for reliable health insights.
Long‑Lasting Battery & Galaxy OS 2.0

Experience up to 10 days of battery life with smart power management, paired with the intuitive Mibro Galaxy OS 2.0 for a seamless, personalized wearable experience.
